ui.title: What your counselors remember
ui.source_note: These recollections come from this saved campaign's records, not remembered chat transcripts.
ui.retention_note: The retained archive is incomplete: crowded seasons and older entries may be omitted. Missing records do not mean an event never happened. Choices do not reveal motives, and former pledges are not reconstructed.
ui.battle_note: Campaign recollections wait until the active battle closes; no mutable tactical state is read.
ui.presentation_note: Finish the turn presentation and Dispatch before reviewing campaign memory.
ui.empty: No eligible saved recollection is available for this view.
ui.unknown_ruler: No living ruler is recorded for your faction.
ui.unknown_since: The current ruler's reign date is not yet recorded.
ui.previous_reigns: Earlier rulers in the retained annals
ui.previous_reigns_note: Reign summaries report the character's recorded lifetime deeds at closure, not deeds earned only during that reign.
ui.previous_reigns_omitted: {count} older reign summaries are not shown.
ui.omitted: {count} other eligible records are not shown.
ui.ask_prompt: Recall the selected saved record {source_ref}: {summary} Put it in context for this campaign, distinguish recorded facts from interpretation, and do not invent motives or unrecorded history.
ui.focus_missing: The selected source is not eligible in this loaded campaign. No earlier campaign memory has been carried over.

marcus.note: Marcus recalls duties, rulers and consequential choices. His interpretation is separate from the saved facts.

lucius.note: Lucius recalls governing choices and changes affecting cities. Historical decisions do not establish current conditions.

gaius.note: Gaius recalls recorded wars and territorial changes. Old victories reveal no hidden enemy roster or present guarantee.

templates.battle: {faction} and {other_faction} fought near {region}. This record does not provide current troop strength.
templates.reign_summary: The annals closed {character}'s reign over {faction}. At closure, the character's recorded lifetime deeds totaled {battles_won} battle victories, {cities_taken} cities taken, {techniques_completed} techniques completed and {edicts_enacted} edicts enacted.
templates.war_summary: The recorded war between {faction} and {other_faction} lasted {turns} seasons and included {battles} battles.
templates.faction_destroyed: {faction} ceased to exist as a campaign faction.
templates.disaster: A disaster was recorded at {region}, held at the time by {faction}.
templates.divine_choice: At {region}, the confirmed choice in '{dilemma}' was '{choice}'. This receipt records the decision, not its motive, the ruler who made it, or whether its policy remains active.
templates.patron_honor: The campaign recorded fulfillment of {patron}'s divine charge. The honor remains a historical record, not proof that the patron is still chosen.
